name: text-animate
title: Text Animate
description: Ten ready text entrances (fade, blur, blur up/down, slide four ways, scale up/down) staggered across words, letters or lines.

moworks.author: magicui
moworks.call: MW.textAnimate(q(".a1"), tl, 0.3, { animation: "blurInUp", by: "character", duration: 0.9, exit: true, hold: HOLD });

options.hold: s between the entrance and the exit (0.6)

credit.author: Magic UI (magicuidesign)
credit.madeNote: ported to GSAP on the film's clock; same timings, eases, sizes and colours; the original is linked

moworks.notes: animation: fadeIn | blurIn | blurInUp | blurInDown | slideUp | slideDown | slideLeft | slideRight | scaleUp | scaleDown. by: text | word | character | line. exit: true plays the matching exit (reverse order).
moworks.titleVi: Mười kiểu vào chữ, tách từng mảnh
